9)༄༅/bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/10)na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ'adir rten gyi gang zag spros med ri sul nyul zhing phyag rdzo

tei:div.tei:p: 9) ༄༅/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 10)

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir rten gyi gang zag spros med ri sul nyul zhing phyag rdzogs don gyi rnal 'byor pas/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar 'dod pas/ dad nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems kyis gzhi bzung nas/ thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// bden gnyis ngo bo bstan pa dam pa'i chos// rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ste// dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs 'bul// nyes bshags dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor// bzhugs gsol 'debs so dge rtsa byang chub bsngo/ /lan gsum/ dkar gtor 'bul ba/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang dag sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po sa bdag gzhi bdag la// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di 'bul bas// bzhes nas mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /bgegs gtor bsngo zhing*/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ gang dag gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// gdon bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i rigs rnams la// lan chags glud kyi gtor ma 'di sbyin pas// gnas 'dir ma 'dug rang rang gnas su dengs/ 11) /gal te bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na/ khro mtshon me dpung gnam lcags thog char gyis// til 'bru tsam yang lhag ma ma lus par// thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par gdon mi za// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni= sogs brjod/ bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa'i rdo rje srung ba'i gur// sra mkhregs rngams 'thug rlung yang mi thar bas// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu gtams pa la// bar chad bgegs kyi gnod pas tshugs mi 'gyur// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun btags sna tshogs snang ba'i chos rnams kun// gzhan dbang sku dang ye shes cho rol du// yongs grub chos nyid klong chen dgongs pa yis/

'pho med ye shes 'khor lor byin phob cig dzñā na a be sha ya a a/ mchod rdzas byin gyis rlob pa ni/ hūm̐/ stong nyid spros dang bral ba'i rang rtsal las// mtshan ma med pa'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// smon pa med pa kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ tshogs zhing sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma dang*/ 'brar dpyod pa yod med skye ba 'gog 12) ngo bor dpyod pa gcig dang du bral gyis// rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid chen por sbyangs// thams cad dpyod pa rten 'brel chen mo yis// stong par ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje'i gdangs// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// stong dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa las// 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rgyal lhun po'i steng*// ye shes rang snang gzhal yas rgyan rdzogs dbus// bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum zhi chags khros pa'i nyams// phyag g.yas thod rnga g.yon pas gri gug brten// zhabs gnyis dor stabs rus rgyan me long mtshan// mdun mkhar 'ja' zer me dpung thig le'i klong*// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs rdo rje 'chang*// o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje'i ngo bo la// rnam pa mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer ni// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis sgeg /dbu la paṇa zhu sku la chos gos gsol// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu glegs bam 'dzin// pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// de yi spyi bor pad zla mdzes pa'i dbus// 'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum pa'i ngo bo la// mdzod lnga'i shing rta blo gros mtha' yas ni// dkar gsal paṇa grub chas can glegs ral 'dzin// de 13) steng 'od zlum pad zlas spras pa'i steng*// kun bzang 'od snang mtha' yas ngo bo la// bka' babs bdun ldan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// paṇa grub chas ldan tshe bum ral pod 'dzin// mtha' bskor brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus pa// til gyi gong bu kha phyes lta bu yi// snang stong ma 'gags rol pa'i tshul du bskyed// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs srog sa bon las// 'od 'phros ye shes 'khor lor spyan drangs gyur/

/spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ chos zad chos sku'i ston pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// tshad phebs longs spyod yongs rdzogs blo mtha' yas// gong 'phel sprul sku'i gar bsgyur bkra shis 'od// mngon sum gzugs brnyan dal 'dir gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi phyag rgya mchog gi sgyu 'phrul las/ ye shes phyag rgya dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor che// las kyi phyag rgyas 'gugs bcings bsdoms myos pas// dam tshig phyag rgya'i rten la brtan par bzhugs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyu gcig pa yi zang thal ye shes gdangs// yig 'bru'i tshul gyi rig 'dzin bla ma ltar// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes rang 14) snang la// mngon gsum lta ba mjal ba'i brda phyag 'tshal// a ti pu ho/ mchod pa ni/ sbyin pa'i me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// bzod pa'i mar me brtson 'grus dri chab sbreng*// bsam gtan zhal zas shes rab rol mo sogs// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dgyes par rol// badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dkar cha bde ba'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi sman// dmar cha stong pa'i rang mdangs rak+ta'i rgyun// mun can dbyings su dag pa'i gtor ma che// rang byung rang shar mchod sprin dgyes par rol// pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling+ta khā hiḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ngo bo skye med 'od gsal mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// rang bzhin 'gag med rig gdangs blo mtha' yas// thugs rje'i rol rtsal gang 'dul bkra shis 'od// sku gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ ho/ bdag nyid gcig pa'i ka dag zhal ma mjal// lhan gcig skyes pa'i lhun grub ngo ma shes// kun tu btags pa'i gzung 'dzin zhen pa rnams// ye shes rang snang dkyil 'khor lha la bshags// yang bdag lta bas mngon mtho'i yon tan sgrub// nges 'byung brtan pas zhi bde'i lam la bsnyen// byang chub sems kyis rgyal ba'i rjes

15) zhugs pa'i// rnam dkar dge la rtag par rjes yi rang*/ bden bzhi'i lam gyis rgyu 'bras blang dor 'byed// mtshan nyid med pas yum don dgongs pa rtogs// nges pa don gyi thabs mkhas nye lam che// rdul bral chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par gsol// ma hā snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor 'dir// a nu ye shes rig rtsal rdo rje'i sku// a ti yo gar phyam gcig ma grol bar// rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med par brtan par bzhugs// byams chen dus gsum rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs// snying rje'i yul gyur mkha' khyab yid can kun// dga' ba tshad med sangs rgyas thob pa'i slad// btang snyoms rgyal ba'i rjes su zhugs nas bsngo/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ho/ rdo rje snying po chos sku mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// tshangs pa rnga sgrar longs sku blo mtha' yas// tshangs chen bkod pa sprul sku maṅga la// sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa rab tu brtan// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo rab dud cing*// snying po sgom gyi snying dang ma bral ba'i// stong nyid phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur shog bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul pa ni/ sku gsum bla ma'i lha tshogs thugs ka ru// zla steng thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis 16) lhun gyis grub// snang grags bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur/ oṃ a mi ta bha mañdzu gho ṣa hrīḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me gu ṇa sa mu dra hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma maṅga la rasmi sid+dhi hūṃḥ zhes pa rnams ci nus bzla/ mthar mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ srung ma'i gtor chog dam can spyi gtor lta bu gtang*/ ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang chog byin rlabs chun po bzhugs so// na mo gu ra bh+yaḥ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor kyi tshogs mchod gtong dus/

bzlas pa'i dus su mdun bum dbyer med dmigs bsgom dang*/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i rjes su bdag 'jug rgyas par blang bar spro na/ ji ltar bltam pa= sogs kyis khrus bya/ bi shwa'i= sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ho/ bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu// thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung la// dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'jug cing smin par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ ho/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'jug par dka' la khe nyen che// dam tshig nyams na brlag 'gyur bas// dam bsrung dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /tshogs bsog pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal= sogs lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ rang gi gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor dang*// tshogs zhing rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 17) gyi// thugs srog sa bon sngags las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes pa rnams char bzhin babs nas byon/ /rtsa sngags rnams dang*/ dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes byin dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ bum pa'i dbang ni/ hūm̐/ bkra shis bum pa lha'i gzhal yas// lha dang gnyis med bdud rtsi'i chus// skal ldan bu la dbang skur bas// snang zhen lha sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogs// rnam smin rig 'dzin nyer thob cing*// kun tu 'od kyi sa non shog /rtsa sngags la/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes btags/ gsang dbang ni/ hūm̐/ yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems// dkar dmar bhan+dha'i nang du bskyil// skal ldan bu la dbang skur bas// rtsa khams yi ge'i rnam par smin// tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob// pad+ma can gyi sa non shog rtsa sngags la/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ sher dbang ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas te// bde ba chen po gsang ba'i yum// rigs kyi bu la sbyin pa yis// dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du gyur// phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob// 'khor lo tshogs chen sa non shog

rtsa sngags dang*/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ tshig dbang ni/ ho/ ka dag me long gtsang ma'i ngogs// lhun grub dwangs shel dri med gsal// brda rtags rdzogs 18)pa'i dbang bskur bas// dri med rig pa'i gnas lugs rtogs// lhun grub rig 'dzin nyer thob nas// bde ba chen po'i sa non shog /rtsa sngags dang*/ dharma dha tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dam tshig bsgrags bzung ni/ gtso bos ji ltar= sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus 'bul ba ni/ deng nas brtsam ste= sogs/ lan gsum brjod pas grub bo/ rjes la tshogs byin brlab na ི / raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhi gnas me yis nyon mongs sgrib pa bsregs// lhag mthong rlung gis shes sgrib mtshan 'dzin gtor// thogs med chu yis gnyis snang bag chags bkrus// tshogs rdzas ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i mkha' dbyings las// phyi gsal kha sbyor bdun ldan dkyil 'khor sprin// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i tsha gdung gzhil ba'i phyir// byin rlabs char chen 'bebs bzhin gshegs su gsol/ e h+ya hiḥ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ tshogs brgyad dbyings su dag pa'i bkra shis rtags// snang ba rgyan du shar ba'i rgyal srid bdun// rig stong rjen par grol ba'i 'dod yon sprin// bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam par bzhes/ gān tsakra pū dza hoḥ bar bshags ni/ hūm̐/ byis pa'i dbang gis 19)ma shes so thar 'gal// ma gus byang sems spyod pa g.yel ba dang*// nyon mongs mang bas sngags kyi dam 'gal ba// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ yig brgya brjod/ tha ma sgral stab ni/ e nṛ tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ rtag chad mthar phyin dbu ma'i lam gyi dgra// 'khor 'das phyogs lhung phyag rgya chen po'i bgegs// rig stong rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du bsgral// snang srid ye sangs rgyas pa'i zhal du sbyor// sarba sha truṃ ma ra ya tā na gā na pū dza khā hiḥ

tshogs kyi dam rdzas rnams/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ a la la ho ཿ tshim par rol/ lhag ma gtong ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ pheṃ pheṃḥ hūm̐/ rtsa khams rnam dag gnas yul zhing khams nas// rlung khams rnam dag dpa' bo mkha' 'grau rnams// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag zhu bde'i gtor ma bzhes// thig le nyag gcig klong du grol bar mdzod// uts+tsiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta ta khā hiḥ de nas srung ma'i gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis man skabs 'dir bya/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ ye grol chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs nas// rang grol rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// shar grol dbang bzhi'i chu bos dbang skur la// cer grol tshe 'dir gzhi thog grol bar mdzod/ /dbang blang ba ni/ sku gsum bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ 20)dkar las// 'od dkar zla zhun dwangs ma dpral bar phog /sad pa'i sgrib dag bskyed rim sgom la dbang*// sprul pa'i sku yi skal ba rgyud la bzhag /sku gsum bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar las/ 'od dmar rtsi zhun dwangs ma mgrin par phog /rmi lam sgrib dag bdag byin rlob la dbang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /sku gsum bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing las// 'od mthing mthing zhun dwangs ma snying gar phog /gnyid 'thug sgrib dag gzhan lus brten la dbang*// chos kyi sku yi skal ba rgyud la bzhag /sku gsum bla ma'i sku yi cha rnams las// 'od zer kha mdog sna tshogs gnas bzhir thim// snyom 'jug sgrib dag 'od gsal sgom la dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /chad tho ni/ hūm̐/ 'khor lo bzhi yi dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba'i// rta skad thengs gsum bka' sdod yal gam can// ru lu 'bru brgyad sde brgyad sde tshogs rnams// gtor ma bdud rtsi rnam dag 'di bzhes shig /sa ma ya hoḥ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa rlung rnam dag bod skyong brtan ma rnams// 'bod rbad gsid phyir bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// rdzong 'phrang srog gi gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs tshogs// thal 'byin rnam bzhis

21) sbyor sgrol phrin las mdzod// ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba ling+ta khā hiḥ bro rdung ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtse gcig mnyam par gnas pas bar chad zhi// spros bral 'od gsal chen pos ye shes rgyas// ro gcig snang sems 'dres pas yon tan sdud// sgom med gsal khyab chen pos bag chags bsgral// s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ rjes chog mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ ho/ bsnyen pas rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskul/ nye bar bsnyen pas gsang gsum byin rlabs bsdus// bsgrubs pas mchog thun dngos grub 'dod rgu'i gter// sgrub pa chen pos tshe 'dir grub par stsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru dzñā na sid+dhi pha la hoḥ

nongs bshags ni/ ho/ rang bzhag gnas lugs yin par ngo ma shes// rang bab chos sku yin pa don ma rtogs// rnam rtog rig rtsal yin pa yid ma ches// 'gal 'khrul nongs mchis chos dbyings klong du bshags/ /yig brgya lan gsum/ brtan bzhugs ni/ bshad rgyud bstan pa'i kaḥchen rnam pa bcu// sgrub rgyud 'dzin pa'i shing rta rnam brgyad kyi// bstan dang de 'dzin rjes su skyong ba'i phyir// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du brtan par bzhugs// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swa hāḥ bsdu ldang ni/ sku gsum bla ma'i lha tshogs rang la thim// rang nyid phag mo nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal/ 22) /blo 'das 'od gsal chos sku rjen pa'i ngang*// skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i dbyings su bzhag /slar yang chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin// rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i// spyi mgrin snying gor rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan// rdo rje'i go chas lus kun rdo rjer gyur/ bsngo smon ni/ ho/ gnyug ma'i ngo bo rang zhal rang thog sprad// 'od gsal chen por kun thag gcig thog bcad// gdeng chen grol thog bcas pa'i dge rtsa kun// 'od gsal 'khor yug 'dres pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// rang bzhin bar dor thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod// 'chi kha bar dor chos nyid sbubs su zhugs// chos nyid bar dor rang snang yid ches nas// srid pa bar do'i 'khrul 'khor zhig par shog /bkra shis ni/ ho/ snang mtha' yas bzhin mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma shar// spyan ras gzigs bzhin blo gros dkyil 'khor rgyas// pad+ma 'byung bzhin bkra shis 'od zer 'bar// 'gro ba'i mun pa sel ba'i bkra shis shog /zhes pa'ang sgrub brtson rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug karma bkra shis kun khyab dang*/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin chen zung gis bzhed skong du/ bla sgrub dang dbang chog bcas rje 'di rnams kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sngags btsun dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal lam pad nor pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/
